_what: How app.audit_logs (db/foundation/migrations/140_audit.sql) reads CTR-AUD-001 (contract-catalog/shared-kernel/ctr-aud-001/schema.json, status Draft, owners A0+A6), written down so a test can hold it in both directions: every column maps to contract paths or is a pinned divergence, and every contract leaf is mapped by a column or is a pinned divergence. If the Draft moves -- a property added, renamed, retyped, made required, or its enum or pattern changed -- the test in test-kits/db/foundation-contract.test.mjs fails naming the path.
_written_by: Batch 141 preparation draft (A0 /claude/a0_atlas drafting subagent, 2026-10-03). It records batch 140's reading and the gaps found in it; it countersigns nothing. Whether CTR-AUD-001 freezes as 140 reads it is Q141-b (A0+A6), not taken here.

audit_id_is_a_uuid_named_id.finding: The contract's audit_id is a string of minLength 1; the store's key is `id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()`. Neither the rename nor the narrowing is among the four divergences 140 declares, and every valid example in contract-catalog/shared-kernel/ctr-aud-001/examples/ (aud_synthetic_0001 ...) is an audit_id the store cannot hold.

scope_ids_are_uuid.finding: CTR-TEN-001 types workspace_id, business_profile_id and page_context_profile_id as strings of minLength 1; the store types them uuid. 140 declares the flattening into §3.3's names, not the narrowing; the contract's own examples (ws_synthetic_0001 ...) cannot be stored.

two_contract_values_one_column.finding: The contract carries actor, correlation_id and causation_id twice -- at the root and inside tenant_context -- and correlation_id a third time inside error; its untestable_by_schema note (3) says nothing checks they agree. The store has one column for each, so it cannot hold a record in which they differ, and nothing says which copy a producer must write. 140's header says only that `correlation_id is already a column here` for the error copy.

created_at_is_store_only.finding: created_at has no contract property. 140 explains it in a column comment (when the record was written, distinct from occurred_at) but does not list it as a divergence.

not_governed.app.security_events: No shared-kernel contract governs it. 140_audit.sql builds it from §5's inventory row and §9.1 alone ("thinner ground than any other table stands on"); CTR-AUD-001 is the audit EVENT and declares none of event_type, source_ip_hash or user_agent_hash. So this file holds no conformance for it, and the test asserts that no contract in contract-catalog/shared-kernel names those columns -- the day one does, this gap closes and the test says so.
